newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan says reforms on intl leased lines delayed.
newsitem.headline: Japan says reforms on intl leased lines delayed.

text.p: Japan's planned deregulation of the resale of international leased telephone lines will be delayed until December due to prolonged talks on international accounting rates with other countries, a government official said on Wednesday.

Japan had planned to deregulate the resale of lines from the autumn, opening the way for foreign carriers and Japanese businesses to launch cut-rate international call services by leasing lines from Japanese carriers.
"There are some issues that should be resolved with partner nations with regard to international accounting rates," said an official at the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications.
The global accounting rate system sets international telephone call charges between nations.
